e: One person is killed in a bear attack inside a ger in Bayanzürkh, Ulaanbaatar.
An assailant, purportedly armed with an axe and yelling antisemitic remarks, attacks a group of Israeli tourists in northern part of the country.
Protesters demanding a greater domestic share of mining revenues carry out a roadside blockade of copper exports from the Oyu Tolgoi mine operated by Rio Tinto.
The State Great Khural accepts the resignation of Prime Minister Gombojavyn Zandanshatar.
